\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಭೂಗೋಳ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಭೂಗೋಳ}} — \emph{bhūgōḷa} — \textquotedblleft{}geography\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಭೂಗೋಳ}} (\emph{bhūgōḷa}) is Sanskrit \emph{bhū}, \textquotedblleft{}world, ground\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 9546), and \emph{gōla}, \textquotedblleft{}ball\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 4321), with the \emph{l} written \emph{ḷ}: \textquotedblleft{}the earth's ball\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}
